summary: Fixed a bug where a camera's notification events could silently go missing from its floor-plan live window (CameraWindow) once that node had enough recent activity across all its cameras: the window fetched the owning node's whole notification feed (capped at 60 rows) and filtered to the one camera client-side, so a camera's older events fell off the page the moment other cameras on the same node generated enough notifications to push them past the 60-row limit - while the badge count (which tallies the full unread set server-side) kept showing the true, larger number, so the list and the badge visibly disagreed. GET /api/notifications now accepts a cameraId query parameter that scopes the list server-side (in addition to the existing nodeId scope), and the floor-plan CameraWindow uses it instead of over-fetching and filtering in the browser, so the 60-row page is now this camera's own most-recent 60 events, not the node's.
compatibility: Backward compatible. cameraId is an additive, optional query parameter (0/absent means no camera filter, matching the prior behavior for every other caller of GET /api/notifications). No schema or migration change. This is a myseliasan-scoped fix and does not touch mymatasan, myidsan, or myiotsan.
